lane: lane/a-tower-icons (2026-11-16): the Burning Tower's item icons, PixelLab subscription gens only (credits $0 throughout)
brief: real 32 px icons for the 28 tower weapons, the 4 tower keys and Hearth Cinders, replacing the interim drawings (standard weapon / Hall Key / coal + a metal pip). Sample of 5 first (CLAUDE.md §10), then batches of 20 or fewer
tool: create_1_direction_object, view top-down, palette hr-world-56-v2 (all 56), 64 candidates a call (10 gens), item_descriptions in slot order, shipped icons as style images
finish: tools/world-art/tower-chest-icons.mjs: a 30x30 pick centred on 32x32, the outline closed (an edge pixel under luma 60 becomes #0b0a0c, a lighter one gets #0b0a0c on its open side), palette and alpha checked. picks/<id>.png are the raw candidates as PixelLab returned them
rule per family: a weapon's fittings are its key's metal (bronze, silver, gold, platinum as the mithril ramp) and its design says whose it was (tower-weapons.js); the keys are one bow shape per metal, each a part of the Tower, never the Hall Key's ring
